title: How to Build a Business That Runs Without You (The Operator Ladder)
rules: Never buy a business to work as a technician. Progress through: Technician -> Manager -> Owner -> Investor.
The 10-20% Profit Share Model: Attract high-caliber general managers by offering market base salary + 10-20% of net profits above a hurdle rate.
Equity Vesting Gate: Never grant immediate equity. Structure 10-15% equity vesting over 3 to 5 years, conditioned on sustained EBITDA growth.
SOP Scorecard: Document top 20 repetitive operational tasks into video SOPs; review weekly KPIs on a 1-page dashboard.
